name: clear-transcript
description: Experimental. How the conversation is drawn inside stock Claude Code: a settled tool group names its files and commands and shows which of them failed, instead of a bare count, and section titles in an answer are underlined, where every heading level is otherwise the same bold. Presentation only: no word the model wrote is removed, reordered or added, nothing is folded, and ctrl+o or /clear-transcript off gives Claude Code's own drawing back. Built on function hooks (Claude Mods), which are early access: it loads only where they are enabled and may break on any Claude Code release. The transcript layer of Clear Claude; independent of Clear Partner and Clear UI.

headings.title: Underlined section titles in answers
headings.description: Underline the # and ## titles of an answer, so sections stand apart from sub-headings. Off: every answer is drawn by Claude Code.

toolGroups.title: Named tool groups
toolGroups.description: A finished group of reads, searches and commands names its targets and shows failures. Off: every group is drawn by Claude Code.
